morio2022.entry: MORIO G, OZAKI H, MORISHITA T, et al. End-to-end argument mining with cross-corpora multi-task learning[J]. Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2022, 10: 639–658. DOI: 10.1162/tacl_a_00481.
